newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - March 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - March 31.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Monday:
* U.S. Speaker of the House of Representatives Newt Gingrich said he warned China the United States would take military measures if Taiwan was attacked.
* A grenade exploded at an opposition political rally in Phnom Penh, killing 10 people and wounding many.
* Palestinian police prevented a feared escalation in violence in the Middle East by keeping a firm grip on Palestinian rioters in the West Bank.
* A survey found U.S. farm workers' wages have trailed inflation for the past 20 years.
* Members of the Heaven's Gate cult who committed suicide were remembered across the United States in services, while the search for answers behind the deaths continued.
* While both U.S. Democrats and Republicans express outrage at charges China might have made covert campaign donations, the United States has long meddled in the internal affairs of other countries.
* Several mysteries surround the story of Bre-X Minerals, which recently announced a large mine in Indonesia contained less gold than originally thought.
